soot-canvas.$description: Soot Canvas — Page background behind every section — a red-tinged black so the crimson glows bleed in without a seam

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Headlines, navigation, body copy and the filled primary button — the only bright fill on the page

nest-crimson.$description: Nest Crimson — The cat logo, the hot corner of every glow gradient and the Devtools showcase wash — red is light behind the page, almost never a flat fill

garnet-sweep.$description: Garnet Sweep — Crimson-to-garnet-to-soot sweep behind the hero frame, stats band and syntax section — the furnace glow that defines the page

graphite-slab.$description: Graphite Slab — Syntax section field, code-editor body and the footer slab with its grain texture

carbon-panel.$description: Carbon Panel — Body of the large bordered code window and dark framed panels that sit one step above the canvas

ash-seam.$description: Ash Seam — Secondary button fill, progress tracks and the 1px seams of the sponsor logo grid

smoke-outline.$description: Smoke Outline — Translucent white 1px outlines on cards, the code window and the testimonial author pill

pewter-text.$description: Pewter Text — Muted Geist Mono labels, hero stat captions, inactive tab titles and line icons

iron-gray.$description: Iron Gray — The newsletter Subscribe button fill, sitting inside the translucent e-mail field

coral-keyword.$description: Coral Keyword — Keywords such as import, async and const in the syntax code panel — GitHub-dark syntax colouring

amber-string.$description: Amber String — String literals in the syntax code panel, the only warm yellow on the page

frost-identifier.$description: Frost Identifier — Function and method names in the syntax code panel, a cool counterpoint to the coral keywords

manrope.$description: The display and interface face. Weight 500 carries everything from 48px section headings to the 112px hero and 128px statements at line-heights near 1.0 and zero tracking, so giant lines read soft and geometric rather than shouty; 16px/500 nav, 16px/700 buttons and 14px/600 footer links share it.

geist-mono.$description: Every paragraph, not just code: hero and section copy at 14px/300 with 24px line-height, uppercase { BRACKETED }_ eyebrows at 12px/300 with -0.3px tracking, stat labels and course metadata at 14px/400, and the 16px/300 syntax panel at 40px line-height. The light monospace makes prose read like CLI output.
